Development command logic for configuring, running, watching, and debugging Firedancer.

# Purpose
This file implements the `dev` command flow for Firedancer. It parses development command-line options in [`dev_cmd_args`](<#dev_cmd_args>), sets permission checks in [`dev_cmd_perm`](<#dev_cmd_perm>), and then starts the system in [`dev_cmd_fn`](<#dev_cmd_fn>) with several development modes. The code can run Firedancer with or without the configure step, with or without workspace initialization, and with or without the `watch` process. It also supports a `--debug-tile` option that selects one tile or the Agave process for debugging, and it disables sandbox mode when needed for that use case.

The file also contains process control and signal handling for development runs. It installs handlers for `SIGINT` and `SIGTERM`, forwards signals to child processes, and writes signal messages to the log or standard error. The [`update_config_for_dev`](<#update_config_for_dev>) function adjusts the configuration before startup by reading `genesis.bin` and setting the expected shred version for shred and store tiles when the value is not already set. The [`run_firedancer_threaded`](<#run_firedancer_threaded>) helper starts Firedancer in a single process for local development and debugging, joins shared workspaces, installs XDP resources when needed, and can run the Agave main function after Firedancer starts.
